title: Sized Wrong
text: Sized Wrong. The pad I received was too small, and not easy to stretch on. My queen mattress is 60x80x9, and thus not unusual in any way. I returned the pad right away.

product_metadata.title: SINSAY Twin XL Size 100% Waterproof Quilted Fitted Mattress Pad, Breathable Noiseless Mattress Protector, Soft Mattress Cover, Deep Pocket Stretch Up to 21" Alternative Filling
features: 100% WATERPROOF MATTRESS PAD: SINSAY twin xl size waterproof mattress pad has an upgraded waterproof TPU membrane that can effectively block all kinds of liquids: drinks, urine, or other accidental spills. No more embarrassment when accidents happen.

SOFT & QUILTED MATTRESS COVER: The surface of our mattress pad is made of high-density microfiber, and the premium cotton filling provides extra softness. The quilted diamond design prevents the filling from shifting while not changing the original feeling of your mattress.

NOISELESS & BREATHABLE: Our twin xl size mattress pad won’t cause any plastic noise when you move or turn. The breathable materials absorb moisture away from your body. The superior quality of the waterproof mattress cover makes sure you can ride the rainbow to dreamland.

PREMIUM FITTED MATTRESS PROTECTOR: Twin XL size waterproof mattress cover is 39''x80''. The high elastic skirt and deep pocket design stretch up to 21”. It protects your mattress from the top and sides. No matter how you toss and turn, the mattress pad cover will stay in place and not fall off. An ideal choice for your expensive mattress.

EFFORTLESS CARE: SINSAY mattress pad is machine washable and dryable. Please wash with cold water, and tumble dry on low heat. Sinsay provides a 90-day refund & replacement with no question asked and 24 hour customer service.
